MailingsView.title: Mailings
MailingsView.subtitle: One message to many customers and vendors – via Telegram, WhatsApp or email
MailingsView.noChannelConfigured: No channel is configured. Set up Telegram (bot token), WhatsApp (Business API) or email (SMTP) in the company configuration under CRM.
MailingsView.telegramHint: Customers can be reached free of charge via Telegram once they open t.me/{bot}, press “Start” and share their phone number – the link is made automatically.
MailingsView.noMailings: No mailings yet – e.g. “Invitation to the Christmas party” or “New Year greetings”.
MailingsView.noLists: No lists yet. Lists are created here or in a mailing via “Save as list”.
MailingsView.copy: Use as template for a new mailing
MailingsView.deleteConfirm: Delete mailing “{title}” with all recipients and the send log?
MailingsView.deleteListConfirm: Delete list “{name}”? Mailings created from it are kept.

MailingEditView.subtitle: Message, sending rules and recipients
MailingEditView.cancelConfirm: Cancel sending? {n} waiting recipients will not receive the message. Already sent ones stay in the log.
MailingEditView.copyForNew: Use as template for a new mailing
MailingEditView.outsideWindow: outside the sending window ({from}–{until}), continues automatically
MailingEditView.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Invitation to the Christmas party
MailingEditView.subject: Subject
MailingEditView.templateFlattenHint: For WhatsApp templates Meta does not allow line breaks in the inserted text – paragraphs become spaces there. The salutation placeholder is dropped because the template itself greets by name.
MailingEditView.htmlHint: Email only. Telegram and WhatsApp always receive the plain text.
MailingEditView.previewEmpty: Once there is a text, the message appears here as a recipient will see it.
MailingEditView.channelOrderHint: Messaging channel: each recipient gets the message via the first messenger in this order that is available for them. Email is added or steps in according to the setting below.

channelHints.telegram: Customers who shared their number with the company bot
channelHints.whatsapp: Free only within 24 hours after a customer message

MailingEditView.whatsappNoTemplate: Do not send via WhatsApp (no cost)
MailingEditView.whatsappNoTemplateHint: Recipients without an open window are reached via the next channel
MailingEditView.whatsappTemplateCostHint: {n} recipients receive a paid template message.
MailingEditView.whatsappFreeHint: {free} recipients within the free window, {closed} without an open window (fall back to the next channel).
MailingEditView.batchHint: Batches protect account and number: better spread calmly over the day than all at once.
MailingEditView.startText: {n} messages will be sent in batches:
MailingEditView.startDetails: {size} per batch, {pause} minutes pause, only between {from} and {until} – expected {duration}. Sending continues in the background even if this page is closed.
MailingEditView.startSkipped: {n} recipients are skipped (no channel or same target).
MailingEditView.startOutsideWindow: Now is outside the sending window – the first batch starts as soon as it begins.
MailingEditView.startedSent: Sending started – first batch with {n} messages sent
MailingEditView.testText: The message goes with sample values to your own address or number – this is how the customer will see it.
MailingEditView.testWhatsappHint: Free only if this number has written to the company in the last 24 hours; otherwise the selected template is used.
MailingEditView.startNotSaved: The mailing could not be saved, sending not started.
MailingEditView.resumeText: {n} messages are still pending and will be sent in batches:

emailModes.always: Always send by email in addition
emailModes.fallback: Email only if no messenger is available

emailModeHints.always: Everyone with an email address also receives the message by email, in addition to the messenger.
emailModeHints.fallback: Email only to recipients without WhatsApp or Telegram.

letterModes.fallback: Letter only if not reachable otherwise
letterModes.always: Always send a letter in addition

letterModeHints.fallback: Recipients without WhatsApp, Telegram and email get a hybrid letter – charged per letter.
letterModeHints.always: Everyone with a complete postal address also gets a hybrid letter – charged per letter.

MailingEditView.letterOffHint: {n} recipients could currently only be reached by letter.
MailingEditView.letterPlanHint: Also by letter: {extra} · letter only: {only} – charged per letter. The letter appears in the customer's letters; closing and signature come from the letter template.

MailingRecipients.title: Recipients
MailingRecipients.suggestCapped: – only {n} more fit into the list
MailingRecipients.saveListHint: {n} recipients are saved and can be loaded again at any time.
MailingRecipients.removeAllConfirm: Remove all {n} recipients from the list?
MailingRecipients.maxReached: At most {max} recipients per mailing – the list is full.
MailingRecipients.empty: No recipients yet. Add via search, “Suggest” or a list.
MailingRecipients.name: Recipient
MailingRecipients.duplicateHint: Same target as another recipient – sent only once
MailingRecipients.noChannelHint: No Telegram link, no open WhatsApp window (or no template) and no email address

hints.telegramOff: Telegram linked, but Telegram is switched off for the company
hints.telegramNone: No Telegram – the customer has not shared their number with the bot yet
hints.whatsappTemplateOnly: Mobile {phone} – no WhatsApp contact yet, template only (paid)
hints.whatsappOff: WhatsApp is not configured for the company
hints.emailOff: Email sending is not configured for the company
hints.letterNone: No complete postal address (street, zip, city)

MailingRecipients.moreHits: More hits available – refine the search (number, city, email).

MailingErrors.WHATSAPP_WINDOW_CLOSED: No open WhatsApp window for this number and no template selected. Message the company from that number first or choose a template.
MailingErrors.WHATSAPP_NOT_CONFIGURED: WhatsApp is not configured (access token or phone number ID missing).
MailingErrors.TELEGRAM_NOT_CONFIGURED: Telegram is not configured (bot token missing or disabled).
MailingErrors.TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: The selected WhatsApp template is not approved or has been deleted.
MailingErrors.MAILING_TEST_CHANNEL: Test messages are only possible via email or WhatsApp.
MailingErrors.MAILING_NO_RECIPIENTS: No recipient can be reached via the selected channels.
MailingErrors.MAILING_TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS: More than 300 recipients are not allowed.
MailingErrors.MAILING_CHANNEL_REQUIRED: At least one messenger or email must be enabled.
MailingErrors.MAILING_WRONG_STATUS: This action is not possible in the current status.
MailingErrors.MAILING_NOT_DELETABLE: A running mailing cannot be deleted. Pause or cancel it first.
MailingErrors.MAILING_LIST_NAME_REQUIRED: Please enter a name for the list.
